CustomField.label: Editable
CustomField.description: Lets users edit this column in the grid. The grid must allow inline edit, and users need edit access to the field and the record. Rich text is always read-only in the grid; long text is edited in a text area that first reads the whole value.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Check to let users edit this column. The grid must allow inline edit, and users need edit access to the field.
